title: Lord of All
meter: Prose (the Upanishad mantras have no meter)
meterNote: The mantras of the Mandukya Upanishad are prose, not verse, so there is no meter to scan. Their rhythm comes from the chant. Notice how this mantra uses pada and matra, the same two words the meter scanner is built on.
translation: This is the lord of all; this is the all-knowing; this is the inner controller; this is the source of all; it is where all beings arise and dissolve.
translation_hi: यही सबका ईश्वर है, यही सर्वज्ञ है, यही अंतर्यामी है, यही सबका मूल है; यही सब प्राणियों की उत्पत्ति और लय का स्थान है।
grammar: Dual: प्रभवाप्ययौ 'origin and dissolution', the two together, like the dual pairs in Tandava verse 12.
Esha / esho: the visarga of एषः drops before most sounds and becomes ओ before अ: एषोऽन्तर्यामी.
